The failure is in the frozen driver file [dcitl_port.py](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L118-L131). In `parse_time`, the PM conversion checks `if ap == "pm" and h <= 12:` instead of `h < 12` (whereas [lab23_dcitl.py.orig](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/lab23_dcitl.py.orig#L122) has `h < 12`). As a result, `"12:30 pm"` is converted to `"24:30"` instead of `"12:30"`, so `Driver.match_slot` finds no matching slot.

Because [dcitl_port.py](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py) is part of the frozen reference driver, this is a `finding` and no files were modified.
